scope: An editorial SKOS/SOSA/DCAT application profile and deterministic alias matcher. Matches indicate potential data relevance, not study validity or complete language understanding.

topics.label: Nitrogen dioxide (NO₂)
topics.chain: NO₂ question → atmospheric column retrieval → TROPOMI / OMI / TEMPO → platform → provider collection
topics.caution: Satellite NO₂ columns are not ground-level concentrations or personal exposure. Check retrieval version, units, clouds, quality flags, averaging kernels, overpass time and validation before analysis.

topics.label: Aerosols and particulate matter context
topics.chain: Particle question → aerosol optical properties → MODIS / VIIRS / TROPOMI → platform → aerosol product
topics.caution: Aerosol optical depth and UV aerosol index differ. Neither is directly PM₂.₅ mass concentration. Surface PM₂.₅ inference needs a validated model, meteorology and ground measurements.

topics.label: Air quality
topics.chain: Air-quality question → choose a pollutant and observable → instrument → product → validation
topics.caution: Specify the pollutant and whether you need a column, optical depth or near-surface concentration. Broad air-quality matches are possible measurement pathways, not interchangeable products.

topics.label: Surface heat and urban heat
topics.chain: Heat question → surface thermal radiance → retrieved land surface temperature → thermal sensor → product
topics.caution: Surface skin temperature differs from air temperature and heat exposure. Cloud masks, acquisition time, emissivity and resampling matter. Health claims need a suitable study design.

topics.label: Vegetation and land cover
topics.chain: Land question → reflectance / vegetation indices → optical sensor → surface reflectance collection
topics.caution: Indices and classifications are derived quantities. Inspect spectral response, atmospheric correction, seasonality, cloud QA and validation labels.

topics.label: Flooding and surface water
topics.chain: Flood question → water extent inference → radar backscatter or optical reflectance → sensor → product
topics.caution: Radar measures backscatter, not a flood class. Detection needs pre-event comparison, terrain/urban/vegetation handling and validation; optical results are cloud limited.

topics.label: Ocean colour and coastal water
topics.chain: Coastal question → radiance / ocean-colour retrieval → optical sensor → product and regional validation
topics.caution: Chlorophyll and water-quality estimates are retrievals, not direct measurements of toxicity or pathogens. Coastal atmospheric correction and algorithm applicability need review.

topics.label: Snow and ice cover
topics.chain: Snow question → snow-cover inference → optical reflectance → sensor → product
topics.caution: Cloud, terrain shadow and forest obscure snow. Snow cover does not determine snow water equivalent or an isochrone. FieldWork's John Snow example concerns cholera and travel time, not snow cover.

routes.label: Sentinel-5P · TROPOMI NO₂ OFFL
routes.access_note: Metadata public; CDSE asset downloads require authentication
routes.note: Check timeliness, version, qa_value, units and averaging kernels.

routes.label: Intelsat 40e · TEMPO NO₂ V04
routes.access_note: Metadata public; Earthdata Login may be required for assets
routes.note: A regional, daytime geostationary pathway. TEMPO is an instrument on Intelsat 40e.

routes.label: Sentinel-3 · SYNERGY aerosol optical depth
routes.access_note: Metadata public; asset access may need provider signing
routes.note: AOD is not PM₂.₅. This route serves Sentinel-3, not every aerosol candidate.

routes.label: Sentinel-1 · radiometric terrain-corrected radar
routes.access_note: Metadata public; asset access may need provider signing
routes.note: Flood maps require additional processing. Inspect actual Item platform and polarisation.

routes.label: Landsat · Collection 2 Level 2
routes.access_note: Public metadata and open-data assets; inspect Item license
routes.note: Collection spans Landsat 4/5/7/8/9. Temperature is a retrieval, not air temperature.

routes.label: Sentinel-2 · Level-2A surface reflectance
routes.measurement: Surface reflectance; vegetation, snow and water inference
routes.access_note: Public metadata and open-data assets; inspect Item license
routes.note: Audited collection summary names Sentinel-2A/2B. Confirm platform per Item; 2C support is not assumed here.

routes.label: Sentinel-3 · OLCI water full-resolution NTC
routes.access_note: Metadata public; CDSE asset downloads require authentication
routes.note: Inspect coastal algorithm validity, atmospheric correction and QA.

routes.label: Aura · OMI NO₂ V004
routes.access_note: Metadata public; Earthdata Login may be required for assets
routes.note: Inspect row-anomaly flags, retrieval version, units, QA and sampling. Archive availability is not current instrument health.

routes.label: Terra + Aqua · MODIS MAIAC aerosol optical depth
routes.access_note: Metadata public; Earthdata Login may be required for assets
routes.note: MAIAC AOD is not surface PM2.5 concentration. Check QA, cloud/snow masks and validation.
